android.desc:
Scan2Sheet turns any receipt into organised expense data in seconds — powered by AI, synced straight to Google Sheets.

Snap a photo of any receipt and let our AI-powered OCR scanner extract the merchant, date, amount, and line items automatically. No manual typing, no spreadsheet juggling — just accurate expense records ready when you need them.

Key Features:

1. AI Receipt Scanner
- Instant, accurate OCR scanning from your camera or gallery
- Multi-page receipt support — long receipts stitched into one record
- Automatic duplicate detection so you never double-count an expense

2.Automatic Expense Tracking
- Extracts merchant, date, total, and line items
- Automatic categorisation — every expense sorted, no manual tagging
- Real-time expense summaries: totals, tax, and averages at a glance

3. Google Sheets Integration
- Syncs directly to your connected Google Sheets
- Build custom expense trackers and reports instantly
- Secure cloud storage for every receipt image on Google Drive, linked from your spreadsheet

4. Simple, Organised Records
- One central place for every receipt
- No more shoeboxes, screenshots, or lost paper trails

Perfect For:
Freelancers & contractors • Sole traders & self-employed professionals • Small business owners • Tax deduction tracking • Reimbursement claims • Personal budgeting

Why Scan2Sheet?
Stop wasting time entering receipt data manually. Scan2Sheet combines AI-powered receipt scanning, OCR technology, and Google Sheets integration to create a fast, simple, and efficient expense tracking solution. 

Whether you're tracking personal expenses, managing business receipts, preparing for tax season, or recording expenses for reimbursement claims, Scan2Sheet helps you stay organised and save time.

Start for free — no credit card required. Download Scan2Sheet today and turn hours of expense admin into minutes.

quotes.text:
After several months of development and refinement, my mobile app, Scan2Sheet, is finally published and live on Apple Store and Play Store.

The idea for Scan2Sheet came from a problem I had myself: managing piles of paper receipts for tax deductions and expense tracking. Manually entering receipt data into spreadsheets is time-consuming, tedious, and prone to errors. On top of that, paper receipts can easily be lost, damaged, or overlooked.

With Scan2Sheet, simply take a photo of the receipt whenever making your purchases. In just a few clicks, the extracted expense data and a copy of the receipt image are automatically saved to your own Google Sheets document. There's minimal manual data entry, and no need to learn or manage another dashboard, database, or accounting system.

Here are the links to download:

- For IOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scan2sheets/id6760991697

- For Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app.scan2sheet

The product's landing page: https://www.scan2sheet.com/

I hope other people also find the app useful and I am happy to hear any thoughts and feedback.
